scope: Existing PostgreSQL and Redis scans, 25 unique HIGH/CRITICAL CVE identities; read-only official-source/physical-archive review.
caveats: No ignore/VEX/waiver or gate change was created. Binary-not-affected findings are evidence, not an accepted scanner exception.
No Docker, compiling, package install, image mutation, runtime exploit test or service impact test was performed.
Absence of a Bookworm fixed package does not prove that upstream fixes cannot be backported or that a new approved base can never pass.
Tracker source-package status and actual binary-component applicability are separate. Two util-linux items have explicit upstream range conflicts.
FTS5 11822/11824 are the same bug per SQLite upstream; both scanner identities remain unchanged.
Raw scanner severity is retained despite some upstream/Debian lower urgency classifications.

GNOME GitLab returned406; official GNOME GitHub mirror commits and one .patch were read. SQLite fossil commit pages/MetaCPAN single announcement were inaccessible; official SQLite CVE table and the upstream Archive::Tar fix commit were read.
